The finance department at LuxFunds is currently experiencing significant operational inefficiencies due to its reliance on paper-based processes for expense reporting and approval. The primary bottleneck is the manual nature of these workflows, which directly causes a backlog of unprocessed claims and delayed reimbursements. This delay contributes to employee dissatisfaction and introduces a higher risk of human error during data entry. To improve efficiency, LuxFunds should transition from paper-based systems to a digital expense management platform. Automating the submission, routing, and approval of expenses would eliminate manual entry errors, reduce processing time, clear the backlog, and improve the overall employee experience.
